title: Toronto Food Tour With Distillery District & Beaver Tails
includes: Poutine tasting at Wildly Delicious (included in the price)
Peameal bacon sandwich at Paddington’s (included in the price)
Guided walking tour of the Distillery District, St. Lawrence Market, and Harbourfront
Professional local guide with live commentary
BeaverTail pastry at Toronto Harbourfront (included in the price)
Butter tart from Eve’s Temptations (included in the price)
Additional Food Purchasable but not included in price.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: This tour involves at least 3.5 kms of walking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Toronto through its most iconic flavours on this guided food walking tour. Begin in the historic Distillery District, where cobblestone streets and 19th-century buildings set the stage for your experience. Enjoy your first tasting, Canada’s famous poutine, before making your way toward St. Lawrence Market while learning about Toronto’s evolving waterfront and culinary roots.

At St. Lawrence Market, explore one of the world’s top food halls and indulge in a classic peameal bacon sandwich, followed by a traditional butter tart. Along the way, your guide will share stories behind each dish and its place in Canadian culture.

Finish your tour at the Harbourfront with a sweet BeaverTail pastry, enjoyed with views of Lake Ontario. This small-group experience blends food, history, and local insight into one unforgettable Toronto adventure.
